summary: Graphic effects on the rendered element: blur, greyscale, brightness and more.
details: Filters apply to the element and everything inside it, after it is painted. Several can be chained, separated by spaces. drop-shadow() follows the visible shape (such as a transparent image) where box-shadow follows the box.

values.note: A shadow that follows the shape, not the box.

gotcha: A filter other than none creates a stacking context and a containing block for fixed and absolute children, just like transform.
